senses.gloss: f. (גְּזַז) arbitrary decision. דיני דמ׳ the arbitration practice of untrained magistrates, opp. to learned courts.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 30b:14">B. Mets. 30ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="A01770"><he>אלא</he></cite> (<cite ref="M00023"><he>מאי</he></cite>) <he>דינא דמ׳ לדיינו</he> ed. (Ms. M. <cite ref="M00133"><he>מגוסתא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) what else should they have done (in lieu of deciding according to the law of the Torah)? Should they have followed the practice of the arbitrators?—V. <cite ref="M00157"><he>מְגִיסְתָּא</he> II</cite>.
